expected.fmt:
import expect_true from "@std/test/test.ms"

fn parsed(text: String) Int:
	match text.parse_int():
		v:
			return v
		none:
			return 0 - 1

test "parse_int":
	expect_true((parsed(text: "123") == 123))?
	expect_true((parsed(text: "-7") == 0 - 7 and parsed(text: "+8") == 8))?
	expect_true(
		(
			parsed(text: "") == 0 - 1
			and parsed(text: "-") == 0 - 1
			and parsed(text: "1x") == 0 - 1
		)
	)?
	expect_true((parsed(text: "99999999999999999999") == 0 - 1))?
	expect_true(("héllo".to_bytes().length() == 6))?
